diamond_path: Harden your aura around you to block incoming attacks.
formhide: Match your aura to the surroundings, which makes you imperceptible.
haze: Wrap yourself in a cloak of aura concealing yourself from even the most heightened of senses.
instantmove: Gather your aura at your feet to travel faster than the eye can see.
violent_break: Channel your aura, recklessly enhancing your strength and cleansing you of any negative effects.
aura_slash_arts_mystic: Condense your aura along your blade and release ranged slash.
blood_ray: Cast your own blood to a piercing ray of magic blood.
ogre_flame: Use your aura to create a pillar of fire.
melt_strike: Charge holy energy into your blade and unleash it on demand.
burning_bullet: Throw 8 punches (24 when mastered), each firing a burning bullet that deals 125 Fire damage. Costs 17,500 Magicules and Aura.
draconic_burst: Gather a massive amount of Aura into your fist and unleash it all at once in a punch that levels the area in front of you, dealing 5x your Attack Damage (8x when mastered). Cannot be used with a weapon in hand. Costs 20,000 Aura.
kamehameha: Energy magic. Hold to gather magicule into a glowing sphere, then release to fire a sustained blue-white energy wave that tracks your aim, searing everything in its path and exploding against terrain. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a wider, far more destructive wave.
death_march_dance_arts_misc: Gather your aura into a ring of devastating aura spheres that come crashing down.
flare_circle: Opens a Gate to Hell from which wicked flames erupt to turn your enemies to ash.
re_birth: Death is not the end for those who left a piece of themselves in your hands.
time_stop: Declare a silent interval in which the world must wait while only the caster remains free.
pseudo_dragon_body: Borrow the body of a True Dragon, if only for a while. The world trembles all the same.
charity: Embody absolute selflessness. Absorb damage meant for your allies, fortify them with powerful barriers, freely share skills, and unleash the pain you've endured as a devastating holy beam.
anti_skill: Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.
weapon_creation: Allows the user to create unique weapons to wield.
battlewill: Channel your will, converting magicules into aura.
icicle_spear: Strike targets with a giant icicle spike from the ground.
wrath: Unleash pure rage and use it to get infinitely stronger the longer your anger persists. Beware of the devastating drawback.
envy: Absorb strength from enemies, buff yourself and debilitate your enemies.
